s.note: Garlic chilli lime butter prawns grilled and piled on a platter
s.how: Toss 600g green prawns with crushed garlic, chopped red chilli, lime zest and melted butter. Grill for 2 minutes a side until charred. Pile high on a platter with lime wedges, ready for the crowd at feeding time.

s.note: Cream cheese and cheddar balls rolled in chopped walnuts and smoked paprika
s.how: Mix 200g grated cheddar, 250g cream cheese and snipped chives. Roll into small balls and coat in finely chopped walnuts mixed with smoked paprika. Chill for an hour until firm. Serve with water crackers and stay inside the sphere.

s.note: Knots baked chewy, buttered and rolled in sweet spice, caramel dip
s.how: Mix 500g plain flour, 7g dried yeast, 1 tsp salt, 1 tbsp sugar and 320ml warm water into a dough, knead 8 minutes and rest 1 hour. Shape into 8 pretzel knots. Boil 2L water with 4 tbsp bicarb soda and dip each knot for 30 seconds. Bake at 220C for 12 minutes until brown. Brush with 60g melted butter, toss in 100g sugar mixed with 2 tsp cinnamon and serve with warm caramel sauce.

m.note: Paprika and pepper rubbed, slow cooked off the bone, sticky glaze, corn
m.how: Rub 2kg beef short ribs with 2 tbsp smoked paprika, 1 tbsp cracked pepper, 1 tbsp brown sugar and 2 tsp salt. Wrap tightly in foil and cook at 140C for 5 hours. Unwrap, brush with 200ml barbecue sauce and roast at 220C for 15 minutes until sticky. Boil 4 corn cobs for 6 minutes and butter them. Toss half a shredded cabbage and 1 grated carrot with 4 tbsp mayo and 1 tbsp vinegar for slaw.

m.note: Chilli cumin flathead tacos with pineapple salsa, lime crema and cabbage
m.how: Dust 600g flathead in chilli, cumin and salt and pan-fry until just cooked. Dice half a pineapple with a little red onion and lime for salsa. Mix sour cream with lime for a crema. Fill corn tortillas with cabbage, fish, salsa and crema.

w.note: Dark chocolate mousse in glasses, biscuit soil, speckled choc egg on top
w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate and cool slightly. Whip 300ml cream and whisk 3 egg whites to soft peaks. Stir the yolks into the chocolate, then fold in cream and whites. Spoon into glasses, chill, top with crushed chocolate biscuits and a speckled chocolate egg. The eggs stay raw, so use very fresh ones and skip for pregnant guests.

d.note: Fresh lemonade blended with ice till slushy, in big souvenir cups
d.how: Squeeze 6 lemons and dissolve 150g sugar in the juice with 500ml water. Freeze in a tray for 2 hours. Blitz with a few handfuls of ice until slushy and pour into big cups with straws. Perfect for a long queue in the heat.
